unit_yield.arithmetic: 3,616 sq ft ÷ 2,500 sq ft per unit = 1.4 → 1 unit
unit_yield.basis: Minimum lot area per dwelling unit for the district
unit_yield.caveat: Lot area per unit only: FAR, height, parking and other standards can allow fewer units, and exemptions (efficiency/SRO units, ground-floor Type A units) can allow more. In a Predominance of the Block (606) district RS-3 can add a second unit at 1,500 sq ft per unit (§17-2-0303-B.1).
unit_yield.lot_area_note: Reduced to 1,500 sq ft per unit (two-unit building only) when the parcel is in the Predominance of the Block (606) district or 60% or more of the lots on the block face already hold two or more units (§17-2-0303-B.1). Ground-floor Type A accessible units are exempt from this count (§17-2-0303-B.2).

tod_benefits.note: Transit-served: minimum parking can be reduced (17-10-0102-B). No density, FAR or height bonus at RS-3: those apply only in dash-3 districts (17-3-0402-B, 17-3-0403-B, 17-3-0408-B (B/C districts); 17-4 (D districts)).
